tennant-creek-3.name: Battery Hill Mining Centre
tennant-creek-3.bio: A gold-mining heritage centre with mine museums, a working stamp battery and underground tours, beside the visitor centre.

tennant-creek-1.name: Tennant Creek Telegraph Station
tennant-creek-1.bio: An 1872 stone Overland Telegraph station 10 km north of town, with a self-guided walk through the original buildings.
tennant-creek-1.hours: Daylight hours; building key from Battery Hill

tennant-creek-2.name: Nyinkka Nyunyu Art and Culture Centre
tennant-creek-2.bio: A Warumungu art and cultural centre on Paterson Street with art, exhibitions and an audio tour of local Aboriginal history.

tennant-creek-4.name: The Pebbles
tennant-creek-4.bio: A small outcrop of granite boulders north of town, known to the Warumungu as Kunjarra and a sacred women's site.

tennant-creek-5.name: Lake Mary Ann
tennant-creek-5.bio: A dam lake 5 km north of town with swimming, canoeing, barbecues and picnic lawns, and a bike path from town.

devils-marbles.name: Devils Marbles
devils-marbles.bio: Granite boulders balanced along the Stuart Highway, known to the Warumungu as Karlu Karlu, with informal tracks and a campground.
devils-marbles.wiki: Karlu Karlu / Devils Marbles Conservation Reserve

iytwelepenty-davenport-range-national-pa.name: Iytwelepenty / Davenport Range National Park
iytwelepenty-davenport-range-national-pa.bio: A remote national park of rugged ranges and permanent waterholes east of the Stuart Highway, reached by high-clearance 4WD.

barrow-creek-telegraph-station.name: Barrow Creek Telegraph Station
barrow-creek-telegraph-station.bio: An 1872 stone Overland Telegraph station reserve on the Stuart Highway with a self-guided walk through the old buildings.

newcastle-waters.name: Newcastle Waters
newcastle-waters.bio: A drovers' ghost town off the Stuart Highway with preserved Jones Store and Junction Hotel and a drovers' memorial park.
newcastle-waters.hours: Daytime; access through Newcastle Waters Station

anmatjere-man.name: Anmatjere Man
anmatjere-man.bio: A 12 m steel-and-cement sculpture of an Anmatjere man, 17 m with his spear, beside the Stuart Highway at Aileron.
